verses.text: Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Jacob to a heb' winh yuninal winhaj Labán, wanxo yalank'e heb' winh icha tik: B'eyumxo winhaj Jacob tik yuj jantak tas ix yik'ek' t'a winh ko mam, xchi heb' winh.
Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Jacob chi' to manhxo wach'ok sna'an winhaj Labán chi' t'a spatik icha t'a yalanhtaxo.
Haxo Jehová ix halan t'a winh icha tik: Meltzajanh t'a slum a mam icham b'aj ayek' heb' a k'ab' ok, ol in b'atnhej het'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at sti' winh t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum, haton ix Raquel yet' ix Lea, yik wach' skot heb' ix, sja heb' ix b'aj stanhwi kalnel winh.

Ayik ix ja heb' ix, ix yalan winh t'a heb' ix: --Ex wetb'eyum, a tiknaik toxo ix wila'' to a winh he mam, chukxolaj in yilan winh, manh ichok t'a yalanhtaxo, palta a sDiosal winh in mam, aynhej wal och wet'ok.
Ha ex tik eyojtak wal to ix in munlaj t'a winh he mam t'a swach'ilal t'a smasanil in k'o'ol.
Haxo winh icha wal to tzin yixtej winh, lajunhelxo ix sk'ex in tojol winh, palta ha Dios jun, max in xcha ixtajok.

Ayik ix yalan winh he mam chi': Ol ach in tup t'a nok' kalnel, nok' tz'ib'iltak, xchi winh, haxo yik ix alji yune' nok', nab'a tz'ib'iltak yune' nok' ix alji. Ayik ix yilan winh to icha chi', ix yalanxi winh: Ha nok' jaskiltak stz'ib'ul ol wak' a tojolok, xchi winh, haxo ix alji yune' nok', nab'a jaskiltak stz'ib'ul nok' yune' tz'alji.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'jiek' nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh he mam chi' yuj Dios, ix yak'an t'ayin.
Ha junel ay jun in wayich, a ix wilani to wan stajni nok'. Ix wilani to a nok' mam chiwa ix tajni yet' nok' nunab'il chi', nab'a tz'ib'iltak nok', ay pax nok' jaskiltak stz'ib'ul.
Haxo t'a jun in wayich chi', ix in yawtej Jun yángel Dios, ix in tak'wi t'ay: Oy, ina wajek' tik, xin chi t'ay.
Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Scham wal hilani to a nok' smam stajni yet' nok' snun, tz'ib'iltak nok', jaskiltak pax stz'ib'ul nok', yujto ix wil masanil tas ix ach utaj yuj winhaj Labán.

Ha in Dios in tik, ix in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach t'a Betel, b'aj ix a sekkank'e aceite t'a yib'anh k'e'en k'e'en ix ak'kank'e linhan, haton b'aj ix ak'kan a ti' t'ayin. Ha tiknaik, aktejkan jun lugar tik, tzach pax t'a a lu'um b'aj aljinak ach, xchi Dios t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jacob chi' t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Ix tak'wi ix Raquel yet' ix Lea chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha onh tik, manhxo jab'ok tas ol kik' t'a winh ko mam.
Yujto icha komon anima kaj t'a winh. Ina ix onh schonhel winh, ix slajanel ko tojol chi' winh, haton ix ak' t'a winh yik ix kik'lan ko b'a het'ok.
T'a wal yel masanil b'eyumal ix yik'ek' Dios t'a winh ko mam chi', kikxo yet' heb' kune'. Yuj chi' jun, masanil tas toxo ix yal Dios t'ayach, yik'okab'i, xchi heb' ix.

Ix yak'an lista sb'a winhaj Jacob yik spaxta winh t'a Canaán b'aj ayek' kajan winh smam winh, haton winhaj Isaac. Ix yak'ank'e heb' yuninal winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh t'a yib'anh nok' camello. Ix yik'ankot masanil tastak winh, ix b'at winh yet' masanil nok' nok' ix yik' t'a spatik smunlajel t'a Padán-aram chi'.
Yakb'an ayb'at winhaj Labán chi' t'a junxo lugar joxoj kalnel, haxo ix Raquel ix elk'ankot sdiosal winh ayoch t'a yol spat.
Hanheja' t'a jun pekti' chi' ix el winhaj Jacob t'a elk'altak, majxo yalkan kilkob'a winh t'a winhaj Labán arameo chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'ankot masanil tastak winh. T'a elanhchamel ix ek'ta winh b'aj ay ha' niwan Éufrates, ix kotnhej winh t'a yichanh masanto ix jawi winh t'a juntzanh tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Galaad.
Schab'jialxo skot winhaj Jacob chi', ix yab'an winhaj Labán to ix kot winh.
Haxo winhaj Labán chi' ix ik'ankot heb' sk'ab' yok yet'ok, ix kot heb' syam winh. Yikxo swak'jial chi' ix jawi heb' t'a spatik winh t'a juntzanh tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix sch'ox sb'a Dios t'a winhaj Labán chi' t'a swayich. Ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: Scham wal a na'ani tas ol al t'a winhaj Jacob chi'. Manh komonok ol ach lolonok, xchi t'a winh.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yamchaj winhaj Jacob yuj winhaj Labán chi' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Galaad, t'a scampamento winh. Hata' ix sb'opax scampamento winhaj Labán chi' yet' heb' winh yet'nak chi'.

Ix och ijan winhaj Labán chi' yalanoch t'a sat winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --¿Tas ix a k'ulej? ¿Tas yuj ix in ak'kan musansatil? Elelalxonhej ix utej ik'ankot heb' ix wisil, ichato t'a skal owal ix yamchaj heb' ix u'uj.
Majxo alkan jab'ok t'ayin. Manhxo jab'ok ix wab'i, tato ma'ay, ix am ex in tak'ejkot t'a tzalajk'olal, ix am och son yet' yunetak tanhb'il yet' arpa ayik ex koti.
Maj in tz'ub'kanelta sti' heb' ix wisil yet' heb' winh wi in chikin. Ichato malaj jab'ok a pensar, yuj chi' icha chi' ix utej a b'a.

Ha in tik syal wak'an chukal t'ayex, tato syal in k'o'ol, palta a k'ik'i t'ak'wal ix sch'ox sb'a sDiosal winh a mam t'ayin, ix yalani: Scham wal a na'ani tas ol al t'a winhaj Jacob chi'. Manh komonok tzach loloni, xchi t'ayin.
Tato tza te naejb'at b'aj ay winh a mam, yuj chi' icha chi' ix a k'ulej, palta ¿tas yuj ix elk'ejkot juntzanh in diosal? xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Ix in el t'ayach t'a elk'altak yujto ix in xiwi. Ha ix aj in na'ani, talaj tzak' pural ik'ankanek' heb' ix isil tik t'ayin.

Tato a junok heb' ayek' t'a tik b'aj ayek' a diosal chi', syalnhej schami. Ha heb' ayek' ket'ok tik syal yak'an testigoal heb'. Say ila', tato ay jab'ok a tastak ix wik'koti, syal ik'anpaxok, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'. Palta manh yojtakok winhaj Jacob chi' tato a ix Raquel ix elk'ankot sdiosal winh smam chi'.

Ix ochb'at winhaj Labán t'a yol smantiado winhaj Jacob chi', ix ochpax winh t'a smantiado ix Lea yet' t'a yik heb' ix chawanh criada, palta malaj tas ix ilchaj yuj winh. Ixlajwi yelta winh t'a yol smantiado ix Lea chi', ix ochxi winh t'a yik ix Raquel.
Haxo ix ix k'ub'an el juntzanh yechel chi' t'a yalanh stz'um nok' camello, ix emkan k'ojan ix t'a yib'anh. Ix ek'chaj winhaj Labán say t'a masanil mantiado, palta maj ilchajlaj sdiosal winh chi' yuj.

Ix yalan ix Raquel t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, yujto max yal-laj in k'e wan t'a ichanh, yujto a tiknaik ya'ay in yuj sb'isul uj, xchi ix, tonhej ix tz'ak yal ix. Haxo winhaj Labán jun, ix ek'chaj winh say sdiosal chi', palta maj ilchajlaj.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winhaj Jacob, ix yalan winh: --¿Tas wal in mul ix och t'ayach? ¿B'ajtil ay in mul chi' yuj chi' tzak' wal och t'a a k'o'ol in a sayanek'i?

Masanil in k'a'el tza say ila', ¿tas junok ik ix ilchaj uj tiknaik? Ch'ox t'a yichanh heb' winh het'nak tik yet' t'a yichanh pax heb' winh wet'nak tik, yik wach' a heb' winh syal yalani mach onh yel skala'.
Ha t'a 20 ab'il ix in munlaj het'ok, malaj wal junok nok' a kalnel, malaj wal junok nok' smam a chiwa ix in chib'ati, malaj wal nok' snun tonhej ix ek' sti'.

Malaj b'aj ix wik'kot jilipok nok' a kalnel ix chiji yuj nok' okes t'ayach, yujto a nok' satb'ati tzin tupoch nok' t'ayach. Wach'chom k'uhalil ma t'ak'walil ix b'at nok' yuj elk'um, ina to ix a k'an stojol nok' t'ayin.
Ha t'a k'uhalil, tzin te tz'a yuj k'ak', haxo t'ak'walil, tzin potzel yuj si'ik, max ochlaj in wayanh tzek' ak'wal.

20 ab'il ix in ek' het'ok, palta ix wak'nhej techajok. 14 ab'il ix in kaj heb' ix isil tik, haxo wakexo ab'il jun, ix in munlaj yuj nok' a molb'etz, haton nok' ix ak' in tojolok. Kotak skal ix in a k'exanh ti'ej yuj in tojol.

Ta wal manh ayok och Dios wet'ok, haton sDiosal winh in mam icham aj Abraham, haton Dios b'aj slesalwipax winh in mam aj Isaac, wal yel, malaj am jab'ok tas t'a yol in k'ab' tzin paxta. Palta ha Dios ix ilan in ya'elal yet' tas ix aj yelk'och in munlajel, yuj chi' haton ix ach kachanoch wa'an k'ik'i t'ak'wal chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Labán t'a winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Wisil heb' ix tik, wi in chikin pax heb' tik yet' nok' kalnel tik, wik nok' smasanil. Masanil tas ayek' tik, wiko'. Palta jun, ¿tasto wal swutej heb' ix wisil yet' yune' heb' ix?
Yuj chi', kotanh ko b'o junok ko trato tiknaik yik ch'oxnab'il tz'ajkan t'a ko kal ko chawanhil, xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix yik'ankot jun k'e'en k'e'en winhaj Jacob chi', ix yak'ank'e linhan k'e'en winh yik ch'oxnab'il tz'aj k'e'en.
Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' schekab' icha tik: --Molb'ejek k'e'en k'e'en, xchi winh. Masanil heb' ix molb'an k'e'en. Jun wal juyanh ix yutej k'e'en heb', ix wa heb' t'a stz'ey k'e'en.
Ix yak'anoch winhaj Labán chi' sb'iej jun juyanh k'e'en chi' t'a sti' heb' syala': Jegar Sahaduta Haxo pax winhaj Jacob chi' jun, Galaad ix yak' winh skuch jun k'e'en chi' t'a sti'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, a jun juyanh k'e'en tik testigo tz'ajkan kuj ko chawanhil, xchi winh. Yuj chi' Galaad sb'i jun lugar chi'.
Mizpa ix sb'iejpaxi yujto ix yal winhaj Labán chi' icha tik: --Ha Jehová tzonh ilan ko chawanhil yik manhxo ol yal kil-lan ko b'a junjun onh.
Tato ol ixtej heb' ix wisil tik, mato ol a say juntzanhokxo heb' ix ol och etb'eyumok, wach'chom malaj mach tz'ak'an testigoal, palta ha Dios testigo, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Jacob chi': --Ina k'e'en b'ul k'e'en tik yet' k'e'en ix k'ekan linhan, haton wal k'e'en ix wak'kan t'a ko kal ko nanhal ko chawanhil.
Ha wal k'e'en tik tz'ak'an testigoal t'ayonh to manhxo ol yal ko k'axpitan jun mojon tik yik skak'an chukal t'ayonh junjun onh.

Aokab' sDiosal winhaj Abraham a mam icham yet' pax sdiosal winhaj Nacor in mam icham, aokab' tzonh ilan ko chawanhil, xchi winhaj Labán chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an sti' winhaj Jacob chi' t'a sb'i Dios, haton Dios b'aj syak'em sb'a winhaj Isaac, winh smam winh.
Ix yak'an juntzanh silab' winh t'a Dios t'a schon jun tzalan chi', ix yawtankot heb' ajun yet'ok chi' wa'el. Masanil heb' ix wa'i, ha t'a chon tzalan chi' ix ek' ak'wal yuj heb'.

Haxo yik ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e wa'an winhaj Labán chi', ix tz'ub'ankan sti' heb' yixchikin winh yet' heb' ix yisil winh, ix yalankan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb', ix meltzaj winh t'a spat yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.
